method.interruption: Cooperative cancellation after distinct verified payload commits; safe progress flushes on disposal.
method.isolation: Fresh process per attempt; source creation and restore archive setup are outside measured attempts.
method.cache: Filesystem caches are not flushed; initial JIT is measured, process startup is excluded.
method.counters: Structured provider invocation events, including control metadata and failed calls; not bytes or all native IO.
method.memory: Sampled process peaks and cumulative allocations; observer path sets/logs included; no total-memory bound claim.
